title: Private Las Vegas Strip Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See the bright lights of the Las Vegas Strip on this fun walking tour. Explore the most famous stretch of Las Vegas Boulevard for a fun stroll and dramatic views of Sin City. As we walk, we will fill your imagination with back-stories and history. The depth and breadth of what we can cover while casually strolling will make this pleasant and easy tour a wonderful option for those wishing to see Another Side Of Las Vegas.

This tour takes you from The Aria Hotel Lobby, past the Bellagio and the beautiful fountain show, to Paris, Caesars, Palace, The Linq, The High Roller, the Mirage, and so much more. Your tour covers approximately 2 miles (3 kilometers) total.
